title: Super Mario Party Jamboree – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Jamboree TV
summary: Super Mario Party Jamboree – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Jamboree TV is the original 2024 party game plus a Switch 2 add-on with new modes built around the console's camera and microphone. If you already own the Switch 1 version, the upgrade pack costs $19.99, one of Nintendo's more expensive ones. The install more than doubles, from 5.4 GB on Switch 1 to 12.8 GB, but that is still small. Nintendo quotes up to 1440p on the TV and 1080p handheld and has not given a frame rate. It supports up to 4 players on one console and up to 20 online, and the physical Switch 2 Edition has the full game on the cartridge.
